compile.nuance: The single defect option ('UWAuth') tests two internal lender controls in one code: (1) whether the assigned underwriter's delegated lending authority covers this loan amount/product, and (2) whether a required second-level review by a higher-authority underwriter occurred. Both are lender-defined risk-tiering / delegation-of-authority policy, not Fannie Mae Selling Guide content -- grepped guide/sections/*.txt for 'lending authority', 'underwriting authority', 'second level review', 'delegat*' (9 hits reviewed: B4-1_1-03 appraiser-referral delegation, B7-1-05, B8-4-01, B8-3-04, B3-3_5-02, B8-5-05, B4-2_1-05/-06, D1-2-01 lender prefunding QC process) -- none address underwriter signing-authority tiers or second-level-review sign-off. D1-2-01/D1-3-02 govern the lender's QC *sampling* process generally but do not specify an authority-matrix control. Typed list_screening on a best-effort basis (an underwriter-authority matrix is analogous to the taxonomy's reference-list lookups, e.g. ARM Plan Matrix) -- a defensible but disputable call given the option also has a doc_presence component (second-level review record).

notes: No literal duplicate options (2nd option 'Yes, the underwriter has proper lending authority' carries no exception_code, excluded from defect_options).
